_comment: EVERYTHING VISUAL LIVES HERE. Edit + click Reload in the UI (or refresh the page). No restart needed.

_voice_comment: Mic is the browser's (free). The VOICE is Gemini TTS server-side — natural, same on every machine, ~$0.015/min. Set engine to 'browser' for the free-but-robotic local voice.

voice._provider_note: 'gemini' = lovely voice, but measured 4-11s per sentence. 'cloud' = Google Cloud TTS Chirp3-HD, ~300ms, needs the Cloud Text-to-Speech API enabled on a GCP project and GOOGLE_TTS_API_KEY in .env. See README.

gemini.style: Say in a warm, calm, reassuring tone, like an experienced Indian bank agent:

_assist_comment: Page 2 (/assist) — a human agent on a live call, with the AI on their screen instead of on the phone. The assist agent holds only the read-only tools; anything that writes becomes a button a person has to click. Set 'instruction' to override the whole assist prompt (see assistant/assist.py for the default).
disclaimer: Demo environment. All customer data, accounts and transactions are simulated.
